notes: Seed catalogue for the Honnavar Food Delivery POC. Six kitchens are real Honnavar businesses with menus transcribed from printed menu photos (menuSource: researched); the rest are fabricated or have fabricated menus (menuSource: fabricated), see each sourceNote.
All phone numbers are fictional demo numbers in the 90000xxxxx block; no real business numbers are stored.
FSSAI references and hygiene-check references are fictional.

All Kannada text (names, categories, dishes, descriptions) is machine-drafted and pending native review, except 'ಉಡುಪಿಯವರ ಪಿಂಗಾರ ಢಾಬಾ' which is printed on the restaurant's own menu, and dish spellings ನೀರ್ ದೋಸೆ, ಪತ್ರೋಡೆ, ಗೋಳಿ ಬಜೆ, ತಂಬುಳಿ, ಹೋಳಿಗೆ, ಕಡುಬು, ಮೀನೂಟ which were checked against Kannada sources.
Prices are as printed in Oct 2026 where researched; seasonal seafood and unprinted items are indicative.
Images are AI-generated illustrations of the dishes, not photographs from the businesses.
